description: A sample player holding one bank of short lo-fi samples at a time, with movable start and end points and a loop

params.text: Picks which sample in the loaded bank plays
Sets the playback rate, which moves the pitch and the length of the sample together
Holds the sample looping between the start and end points instead of playing it once per trigger
Sets how far into the sample playback begins
Sets where playback stops, held above the start point

inputs.text: A gate above 0.5V starts the sample from the start point
Moves the sample selection through the bank, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Adds to the playback rate, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
A gate above 0.5V puts the player into the looping mode the switch also selects
Moves the start point, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Moves the end point, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt

notes: Choosing a bank from the menu replaces every sample in the module, and the number of samples in the bank sets how far the SPECIMEN knob can reach.
menu: Original Firmware — the bank of metal clangs the module starts on
Drum Machines — a submenu of sample banks taken from drum machines
Artist Series — a submenu of sample banks contributed by named artists
Percussion — a submenu of acoustic percussion banks
Other — a submenu of the remaining banks
